standard-dialogue.npc: Welcome [brother/sister/friend]... to our organisation... Ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms... and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world.

options.text: What kind of organisation is this?

steps.player: What kind of organisation is this?

steps.npc: We're a proactive organisation working towards the cessation of monsters in normal civilised human society. There seems to be no backbone in this land so we're stepping up to the challenge.

steps.player: Hmm, how do you propose to do that? I mean, I see people everyday killing goblins around here!

steps.npc: We're mobilising people and we're starting our own society...cleaning out the caves once inhabited by these foul creatures and defending them so that they can never again shelter sub human species.

steps.player: That sounds kind of strange, but hey it's your choice.

options.text: Who are you and what do you do here?

steps.player: Who are you and what do you do here?

steps.npc: My name is Johanhus and I lead these glorious people on a courageous mission called, 'Humans against Monsters', we mean to make this land free of monsters so we can all live in peace.

standard-dialogue-using-the-book-of-h-a-.player: Hey, I've found this, do you know anything about it?

standard-dialogue-using-the-book-of-h-a-.npc: Yes, in fact I do. I wrote many essays for this book, it was a great seller, many people are stirred by the words and feelings in such a tome.
